key.name: enabled-tools
key.description: Ordered list of tool identifiers rendered in the drawing toolbar. Valid values: pen, line, arrow, rect, ellipse, highlighter, text, counter, pixelate. Unknown identifiers are ignored.

key.name: show-color-picker
key.description: Show the colour swatch button and its palette popover.

key.name: show-size-stepper
key.description: Show the -/+ buttons and the current stroke width.

key.name: show-fill-toggle
key.description: Show the button that switches shapes between outlined and filled.

key.name: show-undo-redo
key.description: Show the undo and redo buttons.

key.name: show-clear
key.description: Show the button that removes every annotation.

key.name: show-tooltips
key.description: Show a descriptive tooltip when hovering a toolbar button.

key.name: palette
key.description: Ordered list of colours offered by the picker, as #rrggbb strings. The first entry is used as the default colour.

key.name: default-width
key.description: Stroke width, in logical pixels, selected when the capture UI opens.

key.name: stroke-shadow
key.summary: Draw a shadow under each stroke
key.description: Paint a translucent dark copy under every annotation so it stays legible on both light and dark backgrounds.

key.name: fill-shapes
key.description: Draw rectangles and ellipses filled instead of outlined.

key.name: text-bold
key.description: Render text annotations in bold.

key.name: font-family
key.description: Family name passed to Cairo when rendering text annotations.

key.name: counter-start
key.description: Number given to the first counter bubble of each capture.

key.name: pixelate-block
key.description: Size, in logical pixels, of each block produced by the pixelate tool.

key.name: key-tool-pen
key.description: Accelerator that selects the pen.

key.name: key-tool-line
key.description: Accelerator that selects the line tool.

key.name: key-tool-arrow
key.description: Accelerator that selects the arrow tool.

key.name: key-tool-rect
key.description: Accelerator that selects the rectangle tool.

key.name: key-tool-ellipse
key.description: Accelerator that selects the ellipse tool.

key.name: key-tool-highlighter
key.description: Accelerator that selects the highlighter.

key.name: key-tool-text
key.description: Accelerator that selects the text tool.

key.name: key-tool-counter
key.description: Accelerator that selects the counter tool.

key.name: key-tool-pixelate
key.description: Accelerator that selects the pixelate tool.

key.name: key-undo
key.description: Accelerator that undoes the last annotation.

key.name: key-redo
key.description: Accelerator that redoes the last undone annotation.

key.name: key-clear
key.description: Accelerator that removes every annotation.

key.name: key-cycle-color
key.description: Accelerator that moves to the next palette colour.

key.name: key-increase-size
key.description: Accelerator that increases the stroke width.

key.name: key-decrease-size
key.description: Accelerator that decreases the stroke width.

key.name: key-toggle-fill
key.description: Accelerator that switches shapes between outlined and filled.
